propositions: 836 truncated bridge-echo comments across three Jira issues lack the reconciler marker because truncation appends the marker after the body, cutting it off at 32767 raw characters
Comments are identified for deletion by conjunction: body contains truncation suffix AND body does not contain reconciler marker
Phase 2 executed 827 deletions with keep-one-oldest rule applied per distinct normalized body, reducing REB-2605 (145→7), REB-1931 (298→22), REB-1567 (430→16) with zero data loss

After bridge re-enablement, the keep-one rule must invert to preserve the newest copy whose id is recorded in comment_ids, not the oldest, to avoid orphaning the id-reference and recreating the original defect
The first pass after re-enabling will re-post approximately one copy per distinct truncated comment (roughly 8 total, not 836), then dedupe from pass 2 onward
